tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP 12 /2019 Banglore Dated 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, City Corporation Davanagere during Office hours.
All other terms and conditions as per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be a manufacturer & have manufactured and supplied at least 3 Nos of similar LED Display Hoardings of similar size and features in at least one of the last three years i.e.2023-24 to 2025-26 to any Central/State Govt Organization/ULB and the digital board shall be in operating condition at the time of bidding. The facility should be in satisfactory operation for 12 months as on date of tender opening. AND Similar type of work done or performance certificate issued by competent authority of value not less than 47.50 lakh in at least one of the last three years i.e. 2023-24 to 2025-26.Copies of relevant work order with Indent number and work done certificate(s) issued from competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity & value supplied in the relevant year

Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than amount Rs.21.10 lakhs (Un-conditional Letter of credit from scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. Credit lines/ letter of credit/ Banker certificates issued by scheduled banks.

To qualify for award of this contract each tender in its The bidder should have achieved a minimum turnover of 145 Lakhs in any two of the last five financial years . Audited Turnover certificate issued/certified by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN for the respective years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturing certificate with company details or Company Registration Certificate/ Dealership certificate with company details
Bidder must upload a valid BIS certification for the LED Display &Controller must be uploaded and NABCBaccredited ISO 9001:2015 Certificate.
The bidder should have Class I Electrical Inspectorate License
The LED module must be CPRI tested, and the CPRI test report in the name of Manufacturer should be uploaded.

The bidder / OEM should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central & State Govt. undertakings/ GeM Portal or any major Enterprise / Organization in India for non-satisfactory performance, corrupt & fraudulent business practices, not meeting critical conditions/security clearance etc., during the past. Declaration to be submitted on Rs 100.00 stamp paper.
Bidders shall upload detailed design documents, structural drawings, specifications of the latest technology components proposed for the project, along with the relevant product catalogues
